notes: REF-BM-04: title/description/tags/note editable via PUT, but url is not in the store's allowed-update fields and no url field is shown in the editor, so url cannot be edited. REF-BM-14: search haystack includes raw tag names but there is no `#tag` syntax parsing; searching '#article' does not match tag 'article'. REF-BM-15: search is plain substring includes() with no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis handling. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase parsing; quotes are treated literally. REF-BM-20: bulk supports add-tag, read/unread toggle, archive, delete, but there is no bulk remove-tags action. REF-BM-21: selection is only per-item checkboxes on visible cards; no 'apply to whole filtered collection'/select-all-matching control. REF-BM-23: notes are a contenteditable rich-text (HTML) editor stored as noteHtml and rendered, but no markdown is parsed or rendered. REF-BM-24: no local HTML snapshot and no PDF handling. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user settings for default sort/displayed items/font size (sort selector is transient UI state, not persisted settings).
